display-xl.purpose: Hero claim on the directory — the biggest serif on the site.

display-lg.purpose: Page H1s on submit and ops pages.

display-md.purpose: Section and panel headings; EmptyState titles; deal detail H1.

body.purpose: Schibsted Grotesk UI text at 14-16px; secondary in Warm Graphite, metadata in Warm Ash.

label.purpose: 11px uppercase labels with +0.04em tracking: numeral units, spec terms, stat labels.

numeral.purpose: JetBrains Mono with tabular figures for Rp values, counts, scores, dates, table data.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: The only resting-card shadow: warm three-layer lift on hover, with border strengthening to Strong Linen. Hover-capable pointers only.

shadows.name: header-scroll-edge
shadows.purpose: Edge shadow under the frosted header, animated in over the first 240px of scroll via a scroll-driven animation timeline; clean edge where unsupported.

shadows.name: lightbox
shadows.purpose: Deep modal shadow for the proof lightbox panel over the 78% ink scrim.

shadows.name: pill-track
shadows.purpose: Whisper grounding under the filter pill rail.

shadows.name: logo-inset
shadows.purpose: Glassy top edge on the clay % mark chip.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Clay focus glow behind a 2px clay border on focused inputs/selects/textareas.

motion.name: spring-lightbox
motion.purpose: Proof lightbox pop from its thumbnail transform-origin (motion library).

motion.name: spring-pill
motion.purpose: PillTabs sliding active indicator; interruptible, starts from the live position via layoutId.

motion.name: lightbox-dismiss
motion.purpose: Shrink toward source, or drop downward with velocity-projected momentum after a flick (velocity > 550px/s or offset > 110px); drag rubber-bands at dragElastic 0.15 top / 0.55 bottom.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Instant tactile feedback: scale to 0.97 on :active for anything clickable.

motion.name: ui
motion.purpose: Default duration for box-shadow and border-color state transitions.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Primary easing for entrances, presses, and the collapsible grid-rows transition (180ms close / 240ms open).

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: First-load entrance for cards and inline notices; filtering must not re-animate.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Calm skeleton shimmer; stops entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Movement drops (no scale/rise/springs), gentle fades remain; springs become instant via useReducedMotion.

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgb(250 249 245 / 0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(31 30 27 / 0.07), 0 10px 28px -18px rgb(31 30 27 / 0.22); } .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent-vivid, #c96442); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25); } .ds-logo-word { font-family: "Newsreader", Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1e1b); } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.2 "Schibsted Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-secondary, #53514a); transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1e1b); background: rgb(240 238 230 / 0.6); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #b4552f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1e1b); background: var(--bg-subtle, #f0eee6); }

overview: UltahID reads like a well-set Indonesian magazine index — warm ivory ground, serif display type, hairline rules, generous editorial margins — and behaves like a native app: frosted top chrome, spring-sliding filter pills, a drag-to-dismiss lightbox, and instant tactile press feedback on everything clickable. The direction is user-pinned: Apple craft × Anthropic warmth × ClickUp clarity, carried by a single clay accent.

The deal's value is the typography. Every card and detail page is anchored by an oversized serif numeral ("100", "50%") with a micro uppercase unit beside it; trust marks — verification badges, proof counts, freshness scores, timestamps — ride quietly in mono and muted metadata. Depth comes from warm tonal layering (ivory canvas / white card surfaces / oat quiet panels) and 1px hairlines, never from resting shadows. Cards sit flat until touched.

Refused: the stat-tile wall of identical admin cards. Also refused: any dependence on imagery — brand logos are optional decorations, proof photos are user uploads that may not exist, and every state (empty, loading skeleton, error) is designed to carry its weight with zero images. Mobile-first, light, and legible on mixed-quality connections; all user-facing copy is Bahasa Indonesia.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory editorial ground (#FAF9F5) with paper-white surfaces and oat quiet panels — a tonal, not shadow-based, sense of depth
Newsreader serif display over Schibsted Grotesk UI text; JetBrains Mono with tabular figures for every countable number
One clay accent family (#B4552F interactive; vivid #C96442 reserved for the % logo mark and oversized numerals)
Numeral-anchored card anatomy: big serif discount numeral + micro unit, trust data quiet underneath
Hairline separation (1px warm #E8E4DB) instead of nested boxes; detail page uses the page itself as the surface
Flat at rest; warm ink-tinted layered shadows appear only on hover, floating chrome, and the lightbox
Native-app motion: zero-bounce springs (0.35–0.45s) on pills/collapsibles/lightbox, 120ms press scale, staggered 280ms entrances
Accessibility fallbacks are part of the design: reduced motion, reduced transparency, increased contrast, themed selection and caret

rules.name: The One Clay Rule
rules.body: Clay is the only accent family on any screen: one clay primary action per view, clay for links and focus, clay numerals for clay-toned deals. If everything is clay, nothing is. Vivid clay appears only at large sizes (the mark, oversized numerals) or as sub-4px dots.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Every neutral and semantic tint is warm (OKLCH hue ≈ 40–95). No pure grays, no blacks, no cool blues outside the Mist info pair. If a new color is needed, derive it warm from an existing family.

rules.name: The Numeral Is the Hero Rule
rules.body: The deal's value is the largest type on the card and on the detail page — bigger than the title, always serif, always with its micro unit beside it. Everything else is quieter than the numeral.

rules.name: Serif Sells, Mono Counts Rule
rules.body: A number that sells (discount, score emphasis, stat tile) is serif; a number that counts (Rp, tallies, timestamps, table data) is mono with tabular figures. Never mix the two jobs in one voice.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces cast no shadow until the user gives them a reason — hover, elevation (sticky/floating), or focus. If a design needs a resting shadow to look right, its tonal layering is wrong.

rules.name: The Frost Rule
rules.body: Persistent chrome (header) is translucent: canvas at 72% with 20px blur + 180% saturation backdrop, so content scrolls beneath like paper under glass. Under prefers-reduced-transparency, frost turns solid canvas — design must survive both.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a hairline or a tonal step, not with another box. The deal detail page nests zero cards inside cards; nested chrome is a design smell.

dos: Do make the discount numeral the hero of any deal surface — serif, oversized (42px+ cards, 56px+ detail), with its micro uppercase unit beside it.
Do set every countable number (Rp, counts, scores, dates, table data) in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do separate sections with hairlines or tonal steps (canvas/surface/oat); the detail page nests no cards inside cards.
Do keep exactly one clay primary action per view; links, focus rings, and the caret may also be clay.
Do use the warm semantic wash+line pairs for status, with emerald reserved for verified trust and amber for lead-time caution.
Do design empty, loading (calm shimmer skeleton), and error states that work with zero images — logos and proof photos are optional content.

Do keep all interactive elements pressable (120ms scale), keyboard-focusable with a clay focus ring, and every motion respecting reduced-motion, reduced-transparency, and increased-contrast preferences.
Do write all UI copy in Bahasa Indonesia, plain and specific (real brand names, real terms like H-7/H-30).
donts: Don't use vivid clay (#C96442) for body-size text or fills — it's for the logo mark, oversized numerals, and tiny dots only.
Don't add resting shadows to cards or panels; shadows appear only on hover, floating chrome, or the lightbox.
Don't introduce pure grays, black, or cool blues (outside the Mist info pair); every tint stays warm.
Don't build stat-tile walls of identical cards; differentiate surfaces by hierarchy and rhythm, and compose stats into a single divided strip.
Don't uppercase anything except micro labels and badges; never animate the card grid on every filter change — entrance stagger is first-load only.
Don't depend on brand logos or any raster imagery for layout or identity; the UI must survive without them.
